stateDir.description: Where the user's skill data lives (must be inside the backed-up volume)

skillsDir.description: Where SKILL.md and schema.json are mounted (e.g. /opt/actiq-skills)

workspaceDir.description: Where USER.md is rendered from the shared blocks. Defaults to the workspace next to stateDir; set it explicitly in tests so the file does not land in a shared temp dir
